summary.text: Lordly son of Priam, the last named among the nine sons whom the old king called when he set out to ransom Hector from Achilles.

story.text: Priam called aloud to nine sons and chid them as base children that were his shame — Helenus, Paris, goodly Agathon, Pammon, Antiphonus, Polites, Deïphobus, Hippothous, and lordly Dius — wishing they had all perished when mighty Hector died.
